objectives: Explain in two sentences what a Bulgarian notary is and why the state needs one.
Name the main types of work that come into a notary office every day.
Name the roles in an office and what each role may and may not do.
Use the law margin, the law library, the flashcards and the tests of this course.

cards.front: Who is a notary under Bulgarian law?
cards.back: A person to whom **the state assigns** the notarial acts provided for by law, and who is entered in the **register of the Notary Chamber** (Art. 2 ЗННД).

cards.front: The notary is at lunch and a client needs a signature certified now. What may the clerk do?
cards.back: Prepare the endorsement and wait. Only the notary, an assistant notary within Art. 40 ЗННД or a registered substitute certifies; a certification by anyone else is null (Art. 576 ГПК).

cards.front: Which acts may an assistant notary NOT perform?
cards.back: Deeds that create, transfer, change or end real rights in real estate; acts that recognise ownership or limited real rights in real estate; notarial wills and their revocation; mortgages (Art. 40(1) ЗННД).

cards.front: A deed is signed at 11:00 on Tuesday. By when does it reach the registry office?
cards.back: **The same day** (Art. 25(5) ЗННД). Until the entry, the parties get no copy of the deed.

cards.front: Where and when are deeds that need entry issued?
cards.back: Only **in the office** of the notary and only **in working hours** (Art. 573(2) ГПК).

cards.front: What evidential force does a notarial certification have?
cards.back: It is an **official document**: it proves the facts it certifies until somebody proves the contrary (Art. 179 ГПК).

cards.front: What duty of secrecy do employees of the notary have?
A buyer does not speak Bulgarian. What follows?
cards.back: The document stays in Bulgarian. When the notary does not know the language of the buyer, the notary appoints an interpreter (Art. 582 ГПК).

cards.front: How long are the notarial books with deeds kept?
cards.back: **100 years**, then they go to the State Archives (Art. 28а(3) ЗННД).

cards.front: What is the euro conversion rate for amounts in leva in legal acts?
cards.back: **1.95583 leva = 1 euro**, with rounding to the cent (Art. 11–13 ЗВЕРБ).

quiz.question: Who assigns notarial functions to the notary?
options: The State
The Notary Chamber
The district court
The municipality
quiz.explanation: Art. 2(1) ЗННД: the notary is a person to whom the state assigns the notarial acts. The Notary Chamber only keeps the register in which the notary is entered (Art. 2(2)).

quiz.question: A client asks the secretary to certify a signature because the notary is at lunch. What is right?
options: The secretary refuses; only the notary, an assistant or a substitute certifies
The secretary certifies, and the notary countersigns the endorsement in the afternoon
The secretary certifies signatures, but never deeds or wills
The secretary certifies, because the client is well known to the office
quiz.explanation: The notary performs the notarial acts personally (Art. 2(3) ЗННД); an assistant notary acts within Art. 40 and a substitute under Art. 46. A certification by a person without that right is null (Art. 576 ГПК), so a later countersignature cures nothing.

quiz.question: Which act may an assistant notary perform on the instructions of the notary?
options: Certification of the signature on a power of attorney
A notarial deed for the sale of an apartment in Sofia
A notarial will of an elderly client of the office
A mortgage deed in favour of the bank of the buyer
quiz.explanation: Art. 40(1) ЗННД excludes from the assistant's powers the deeds for real rights in real estate, the acts that recognise ownership, notarial wills and their revocation, and mortgages. A certification of a signature is none of these.

quiz.question: A notarial deed for a sale of land is signed on Tuesday. When must the notary present it for entry?
options: On Tuesday
Within 7 days
Within 14 days
When the buyer asks
quiz.explanation: Art. 25(5) ЗННД: the notary presents the deed for entry on the day it is made. The seven-day term belongs to the notice to the municipality (Art. 51(2) ЗМДТ), not to the entry.

quiz.question: Where can a notary issue a deed that must be entered in the property register?
options: Only in the office, in working hours
In the office, also out of hours
At the home of a party who cannot come
Anywhere in the district of the notary
quiz.explanation: Art. 573(2) ГПК: deeds subject to entry are issued only in the office and only in working hours. The exception of Art. 573(3), outside the office or out of hours for good reasons, covers the other acts, such as a signature certification, not deeds.

quiz.question: A notary certified Ivan's signature on a declaration. What does the certification prove in court?
options: That Ivan signed before the notary, until the contrary is proved
That the facts in the declaration are true, until the contrary is proved
That Ivan signed, but only for one year after the date
Nothing more than a private document proves
quiz.explanation: The endorsement is an official document (Art. 179(1) ГПК): it proves what the notary certified, here who signed and when. It does not prove that the declared facts are true; a private document proves only that its author made the statement (Art. 180 ГПК).

quiz.question: Who keeps the register in which notaries and assistant notaries are entered?
options: The Notary Chamber
The Ministry of Justice
The Registry Agency
The Supreme Court of Cassation
quiz.explanation: Art. 5 ЗННД: the register of notaries and assistant notaries is kept at the Notary Chamber. The Ministry of Justice orders the entries and controls notaries; the Registry Agency keeps the property and commercial registers.

quiz.question: Since 1 January 2026, how do you read an amount of 30 лв. in the notarial tariff?
options: As 15.34 euro
As 30.00 euro
As 15.00 euro
As 60.00 euro
quiz.explanation: Art. 12 and 13 ЗВЕРБ: an amount in leva in a legal act applies as the amount divided by 1.95583 and rounded to the cent: 30 ÷ 1.95583 = 15.338… → 15.34 euro. "15 euro" drops the rounding rule; "30 euro" ignores the conversion.

quiz.question: The notary is on holiday. The assistant notary, who is not a registered substitute, is asked to issue a mortgage deed. What follows?
options: The assistant refuses; a mortgage deed is outside the assistant's powers
The assistant issues it; the notary confirms the deed after the holiday
The assistant issues it, because the notary is absent from the office
The assistant issues it with the addition "помощник" to the signature
quiz.explanation: Art. 40(1) ЗННД excludes mortgages, real-estate deeds, acts recognising ownership and wills from the assistant's powers; only a registered substitute (Art. 46(1)) acts alone in everything. A deed by an assistant without that power is null (Art. 576 ГПК).

quiz.question: How long does the notary keep the book with the deeds that are subject to entry?
options: 100 years
10 years
50 years
Until the notary retires
quiz.explanation: Art. 28а(3) ЗННД: the alphabetical index, the register of wills and deposits, and the books of deeds and of notarial wills are kept for 100 years and then go to the State Archives. The general register and the book of invitations are kept for 10 years (Art. 28а(2)).
